question: A person invested ₹8,000 in one scheme at 6% simple interest and ₹5,000 in another scheme at 8% simple interest for the same duration. If he received a total interest of ₹1,760 from both investments, what was the duration (time period) of the investments?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simple Interest for 1 year from the 1st scheme = 6% of ₹8,000 = ₹480

Simple Interest for 1 year from the 2nd scheme = 8% of ₹5,000 = ₹400

Total Simple Interest generated in 1 year = 480 + 400 = ₹880

Total time duration = Total Interest Received ÷ 1 Year Interest = 1760 ÷ 880 = 2 years

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

**Given:**

Principal of 1st investment (P₁) = ₹8,000

Rate of 2nd investment (R₂) = 8%

Total Simple Interest (SI) = ₹1,760
